description:
Move the one integration test that builds a repository through libgit2 onto the shared git repository fixture.

## Background

- `test_add_pinned_document_uses_pinned_document_and_asset_bytes` (`crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/document_event_log_tests.rs:253`) builds its commit through libgit2 (`git2::Repository::init` at `:259`, `git2::Signature` at `:272`), reaching the crate's normal `git2` dependency.
- `jit::test_harness` offers a git repository fixture that initializes, writes and commits through the git CLI.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The test builds its commit with the repository fixture, names no `git2` item, and asserts what it asserts today.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Pinned-document test builds its commit through the git fixture
